## Bug Description

The production Compose files explicitly enumerate backend environment variables but omit supported, documented settings including `AUTHENTIK_SCOPES`, `AUTHENTIK_AUTO_CREATE_USERS`, `DB_POOL_SIZE`, `DB_MAX_OVERFLOW`, and `DB_POOL_RECYCLE`.

Values placed in the repository-root `.env` are used for Compose interpolation but are not automatically injected into the container unless listed. Operators can configure these documented variables and still receive backend defaults.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Set one of the omitted variables in the root `.env`, for example `AUTHENTIK_AUTO_CREATE_USERS=false` or `DB_POOL_SIZE=7`.
2. Render or start `docker-compose.yml` or `docker-compose.prod.yml`.
3. Inspect the backend container environment/effective settings.
4. Observe that the configured value is absent.

## Expected Behavior

Every documented deploy-time setting is passed to the backend container.

## Actual Behavior

Several settings declared by `Settings` and documented in `.env.example` / operations docs are silently ignored by the shipped Compose stacks.

## Environment

- Reviewed revision: `974cf7c`
- App version: `1.7.1`
- Shipped source-build and prebuilt-image Compose files

## Relevant Files/Components

- `docker-compose.yml`
- `docker-compose.prod.yml`
- `backend/app/core/config.py`
- `.env.example`
- `docs/OPERATIONS.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both production Compose files propagate every supported documented backend variable.
- [ ] Defaults remain aligned with `backend/app/core/config.py`.
- [ ] CI renders Compose with sentinel values and verifies they reach the backend service environment.
- [ ] Documentation clearly distinguishes Compose interpolation from container injection.
- [ ] Add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased] / Fixed`.

# Family Tree — full web application stack, built from source.
#
# PostgreSQL is NOT part of this stack (as is common for e.g. Unraid apps):
# run your own Postgres and point the backend at it via the .env file
# (POSTGRES_* values or a full DATABASE_URL). For development,
# `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db` starts a local Postgres.
# Redis is also external — set REDIS_URL in your .env to enable it (optional).
#
# Configure via a .env file next to this one (see .env.example). The headline
# settings:
#   UI_PORT        host port the web UI is served on
#   APP_DATA_PATH  host path for application data (backend appdata: exports, logs)
#   DATA_PATH      host path for the "real" data (member photos, gallery media)
#   POSTGRES_*     where to reach your PostgreSQL instance
#   REDIS_URL      optional external Redis (leave unset to run without Redis)

services:
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    environment:
      ENVIRONMENT: production
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_KEY:?Set SECRET_KEY in your .env}
      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL:-}
      POSTGRES_HOST: ${POSTGRES_HOST:?Set POSTGRES_HOST (or DATABASE_URL) in your .env}
      POSTGRES_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-familytree}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-familytree}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-familytree}
      DATA_PATH: /data
      APP_DATA_PATH: /appdata
      FRONTEND_URL: ${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:${UI_PORT:-8080}}
      CORS_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:${UI_PORT:-8080}}
      ALLOW_SELF_REGISTRATION: ${ALLOW_SELF_REGISTRATION:-false}
      FIRST_ADMIN_USERNAME: ${FIRST_ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}
      FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}
      FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@example.com}
      AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_ID: ${AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_ID:-}
      AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      AUTHENTIK_DISCOVERY_URL: ${AUTHENTIK_DISCOVERY_URL:-}
      AUTHENTIK_ADMIN_GROUP: ${AUTHENTIK_ADMIN_GROUP:-family-tree-admins}
      REDIS_URL: ${REDIS_URL:-} # optional external Redis; leave unset to disable
      WORKERS: ${WORKERS:-1} # uvicorn worker processes; WORKERS > 1 requires REDIS_URL
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_PATH:-./data}:/data
      - ${APP_DATA_PATH:-./appdata}/backend:/appdata
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          'python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen(''http://localhost:8000/api/health/ready'')"',
        ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: frontend/Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${UI_PORT:-8080}:8080"
    restart: unless-stopped

"""Application configuration.

All settings are read from environment variables (or an optional ``.env`` file),
which makes the service straightforward to configure from ``docker-compose``.
"""

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Annotated

from pydantic import field_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, NoDecode, SettingsConfigDict

# Load the repo-root .env regardless of the process working directory — the
# same file docker-compose reads, so there is exactly one place to configure
# the stack. Real environment variables (e.g. those injected by docker-compose)
# still take precedence over the file, so containers don't need a .env at all.
_ENV_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / ".env"


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=str(_ENV_FILE), env_file_encoding="utf-8", extra="ignore"
    )

    # --- General -----------------------------------------------------------
    APP_NAME: str = "Family Tree"
    APP_VERSION: str = "dev"
    APP_REVISION: str = "dev"
    APP_BUILD_DATE: str = ""
    # Host/dev default. The shipped docker-compose files inject
    # ENVIRONMENT=production explicitly (real env vars take precedence over
    # this default and over the .env file), so real deployments still run the
    # production credential validation below; a host-run dev backend does not.
    ENVIRONMENT: str = "development"
    API_PREFIX: str = "/api"

    # Secret used to sign JWTs and the OAuth session cookie. MUST be overridden
    # in production via the environment.
    SECRET_KEY: str = "change-me-in-production"
    ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 60 * 24 * 7  # 7 days
    JWT_ALGORITHM: str = "HS256"

    # How often the background sweep purges users whose deletion grace period
    # has elapsed (also runs once at startup).
    DELETION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS: int = 60 * 60  # 1 hour

    # --- Database ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Either provide a full DATABASE_URL or the individual POSTGRES_* parts.
    # The default host is "localhost" so a host-run dev backend connects to the
    # db published by `docker compose up -d db` with no extra config; in
    # production docker-compose sets POSTGRES_HOST=db (the service name).
    DATABASE_URL: str | None = None

    # --- Redis (optional) --------------------------------------------------
    # External Redis instance — not bundled in the compose stack.
    # Leave unset to disable Redis entirely (graceful degradation).
    # Supported schemes: redis://, rediss:// (TLS), REDACTED
    REDIS_URL: str | None = None
    POSTGRES_HOST: str = "localhost"
    POSTGRES_PORT: int = 5432
    POSTGRES_USER: str = "familytree"
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: str = "familytree"
    POSTGRES_DB: str = "familytree"

    # Connection pool sizing. SQLAlchemy's QueuePool defaults (5 + 10 overflow)
    # are too small given the ~40-thread sync request threadpool. Keep
    # (DB_POOL_SIZE + DB_MAX_OVERFLOW) * WORKERS below Postgres max_connections
    # (default 100). DB_POOL_RECYCLE drops connections older than N seconds to
    # avoid stale ones behind an idle-timeout proxy/Postgres.
    DB_POOL_SIZE: int = 20
    DB_MAX_OVERFLOW: int = 10
    DB_POOL_RECYCLE: int = 1800  # seconds (30 min)

    # Number of uvicorn worker processes (mirrors the WORKERS env the Docker
    # CMD passes to `uvicorn --workers`). Read here purely so the app can warn
    # at startup when WORKERS > 1 without REDIS_URL — a config that silently
    # drops SSE events across workers.
    WORKERS: int = 1

    # --- Filesystem paths --------------------------------------------------
    # DATA_PATH      -> the "real" user data (member photos, gallery media).
    # APP_DATA_PATH  -> application working data (exports, temp files, ...).
    #
    # Defaults are dev-friendly relative paths so running the backend directly
    # (e.g. `uv run uvicorn ...`) works out of the box. In Docker these are set
    # to absolute /data and /appdata via the compose environment.
    DATA_PATH: Path = Path("./.data")
    APP_DATA_PATH: Path = Path("./.appdata")

    # --- CORS / frontend ---------------------------------------------------
    # Comma separated list of allowed origins for the browser SPA. NoDecode
    # stops pydantic-settings from JSON-parsing the env value so the validator
    # below can split a plain comma-separated string.
    CORS_ORIGINS: Annotated[list[str], NoDecode] = [
        "http://localhost",
        "http://localhost:1420",
    ]
    # Absolute URL the SPA is served from; used to redirect back after OAuth.
    FRONTEND_URL: str = "http://localhost"

    # --- Authentication ----------------------------------------------------
    ALLOW_SELF_REGISTRATION: bool = False

    # Brute-force protection for /auth/login: after LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS failed
    # attempts (per client IP + username) within the window, further attempts
    # are rejected with 429 until the window rolls off.
    LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS: int = 5
    LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS: int = 900  # 15 minutes

    # Brute-force protection for password-gated public-tree unlocks.
    PUBLIC_UNLOCK_MAX_ATTEMPTS: int = 5
    PUBLIC_UNLOCK_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS: int = 900  # 15 minutes

    # Seed admin account, created on first start if no users exist.
    FIRST_ADMIN_USERNAME: str = "admin"
    FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: str = "admin"
    FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL: str = "admin@example.com"

    # --- Authentik (OIDC) --------------------------------------------------
    AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_ID: str | None = None
    AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET: str | None = None
    # The OpenID Connect discovery document, e.g.
    # https://authentik.example.com/application/o/family-tree/.well-known/openid-configuration
    AUTHENTIK_DISCOVERY_URL: str | None = None
    AUTHENTIK_SCOPES: str = "openid email profile"
    # New users signing in through Authentik are auto-provisioned.
    AUTHENTIK_AUTO_CREATE_USERS: bool = True
    # Username/group that should be granted admin when provisioned via Authentik.
    AUTHENTIK_ADMIN_GROUP: str = "family-tree-admins"

    @field_validator("CORS_ORIGINS", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _split_origins(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return [v.strip() for v in value.split(",") if v.strip()]
        return value

    @property
    def sqlalchemy_database_uri(self) -> str:
        if self.DATABASE_URL:
            return self.DATABASE_URL
        return (
            f"postgresql+psycopg2://{self.POSTGRES_USER}:{self.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
            f"@{self.POSTGRES_HOST}:{self.POSTGRES_PORT}/{self.POSTGRES_DB}"
        )

    @property
    def redis_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.REDIS_URL)

    @property
    def authentik_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return bool(
            self.AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_ID
            and self.AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET
            and self.AUTHENTIK_DISCOVERY_URL
        )

    @property
    def media_root(self) -> Path:
        return self.DATA_PATH / "media"


@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()


settings = get_settings()


def validate_production_credentials(config: Settings = settings) -> None:
    """Refuse to start production with known placeholders or weak secrets."""
    if config.ENVIRONMENT.lower() != "production":
        return

    secret = config.SECRET_KEY.strip()
    insecure_secrets = {
        "change-me-in-production",
        "change-me-please-generate-a-long-random-value",
        "dev-secret-change-me",
        "e2e-secret-not-for-production",
    }
    if (
        len(secret) < 32
        or secret.lower() in insecure_secrets
        or secret.lower().startswith("change-me")
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SECRET_KEY must be a unique random value of at least 32 characters "
            "in production"
        )

    if config.authentik_enabled:
        return

    admin_password = config.FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD.strip()
    if (
        len(admin_password.encode("utf-8")) < 12
        or admin_password.lower() in {"admin", "password", "change-me"}
        or admin_password.lower().startswith("change-me")
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD must be a non-placeholder value of at least "
            "12 UTF-8 bytes in production"
        )

Family Tree supports Authentik as an optional single-sign-on provider next to

  `default-provider-authorization-explicit-consent`)
- **Client type**: `Confidential`
- **Redirect URI** (strict):

  ```
  https://family.example.com/api/auth/oauth/authentik/callback
  ```

  This is exactly `${FRONTEND_URL}/api/auth/oauth/authentik/callback` — the
  callback goes through the frontend's `/api` proxy, not directly to the
  backend.

- **Scopes**: keep the defaults `openid`, `email`, `profile`. Authentik's
  built-in `profile` scope mapping already includes the user's `groups`
  claim, which Family Tree uses for admin sync (below).

Note the generated **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

### 2. Create the application (in Authentik)

**Applications → Applications → Create**:

- **Name**: `Family Tree`, **Slug**: `family-tree`
- **Provider**: the provider from step 1

The slug determines the discovery URL:

```
https://authentik.example.com/application/o/family-tree/.well-known/openid-configuration
```

Open that URL in a browser — it must return JSON. If it 404s, the slug doesn't
match.

### 3. (Optional) Create the admin group

Members of one Authentik group are made Family Tree admins. Create a group
(default expected name: `family-tree-admins`) under **Directory → Groups** and
add the relevant users.

Group membership is synced on **every** Authentik login, in both directions:
adding a user to the group grants admin on their next login, removing them
revokes it. Admin status of _local_ accounts is never touched by this sync.

AUTHENTIK_CLIENT_SECRET=<client secret from step 1>
AUTHENTIK_DISCOVERY_URL=https://authentik.example.com/application/o/family-tree/.well-known/openid-configuration
REDACTED
```

| Variable                      | Default                | Effect                                                                                                                                         |

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

# Cancel superseded in-progress runs on the same PR. Never cancel push/tag
# runs — those publish container images and must run to completion.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  checks:
    name: "Checks"
    uses: ./.github/workflows/checks.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

  # Aggregate gate so the existing required status check named
  # "Check Application Build" (branch protection) keeps being reported.
  check-build:
    name: "Check Application Build"
    needs: [checks]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: "Require all checks to pass"
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.checks.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "One or more required checks failed (${{ needs.checks.result }})."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All checks passed."

  # Compatibility status for existing branch protection. The actual
  # `npm run check-i18n` command runs in the frontend job inside checks.yml.
  i18n-status:
    name: "Check for Missing i18n Keys"
    needs: [checks]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: "Require frontend i18n step to pass"
        run: |
          res="${{ needs.checks.outputs.frontend_result }}"
          echo "frontend=$res"
          # "skipped" means the PR touched no frontend files — nothing to check.
          if [ "$res" != "success" ] && [ "$res" != "skipped" ]; then
            echo "The frontend job runs npm run check-i18n and did not pass."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "i18n OK (frontend job: $res)."

  release-e2e:
    name: "Release Playwright E2E"
    needs: [check-build]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-e2e.yml

  images:
    name: "Publish images"
    needs: [check-build, release-e2e]
    if: |
      always() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) &&
      needs.check-build.result == 'success' &&
      (!startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || needs.release-e2e.result == 'success')

      contents: read
      packages: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write

name: Checks

# Reusable: build/test/lint everything and report whether it passed. Called
# by check-build.yml on every push/PR — including the release workflow's
# release PRs, so a release exercises this exact suite before it can merge.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      run-all:
        description: >-
          Run every area's checks regardless of changed paths. Release runs
          must always validate the full app, not just what a diff touched.
        type: boolean
        default: false
        required: false
    outputs:
      frontend_result:
        description: "Result of the frontend job (success/skipped/failure/...)."
        value: ${{ jobs.result.outputs.frontend_result }}
      passed:
        description: "true if every required check passed (or was legitimately skipped)."
        value: ${{ jobs.result.outputs.passed }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  # Detect which areas a PR touched so the irrelevant heavy jobs can be
  # skipped. On push/tag/run-all we always run everything (full validation).
  changes:
    name: "Detect changed areas"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      frontend: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.frontend }}
      backend: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.backend }}
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Filter changed paths"
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v4
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            frontend:
              - 'frontend/**'
              - '.github/workflows/checks.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/check-build.yml'
            backend:
              - 'backend/**'
              - '.github/workflows/checks.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/check-build.yml'

  frontend:
    name: "Frontend (build + test + i18n)"
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ inputs.run-all || github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.frontend == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Set up Node.js"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: npm ci

      - name: "Type-check & build"
        run: npm run build

      - name: "Bundle size budget"
        run: npm run check-bundle-size

      - name: "Unit tests"
        run: npx vitest run

      - name: "Translation parity"
        run: npm run check-i18n

      - name: "No explicit any"
        run: npm run check-no-any

  backend:
    name: "Backend (deps + checks)"
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ inputs.run-all || github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.backend == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Set up uv"
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: "Lint (ruff)"
        run: uv run ruff check

      - name: "Compile & import checks"
        run: |
          uv run python -m compileall -q app alembic
          uv run python -c "import app.main; print('app imports OK')"

      - name: "Unit tests"
        # -n auto fans the suite across the runner's cores (pytest-xdist).
        # Tests are isolation-safe: each gets its own SQLite DB via tmp_path.
        run: uv run pytest -n auto

  version-policy:
    name: "Version metadata policy"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Check package metadata"
        run: |
          PACKAGE_VERSION=$(jq -r .version frontend/package.json)
          LOCK_VERSION=$(jq -r .version frontend/package-lock.json)
          LOCK_ROOT_VERSION=$(jq -r '.packages[""].version' frontend/package-lock.json)
          PYPROJECT_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' backend/pyproject.toml | head -1)
          UV_LOCK_VERSION=$(grep -A1 '^name = "family-tree-backend"$' backend/uv.lock | sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p')

          echo "frontend/package.json:      $PACKAGE_VERSION"
          echo "frontend/package-lock.json: $LOCK_VERSION"
          echo "lock root package:          $LOCK_ROOT_VERSION"
          echo "backend/pyproject.toml:     $PYPROJECT_VERSION"
          echo "backend/uv.lock:            $UV_LOCK_VERSION"

          if [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$LOCK_VERSION" ] || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$LOCK_ROOT_VERSION" ] \
            || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$PYPROJECT_VERSION" ] || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$UV_LOCK_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Version metadata is out of sync across frontend/backend."
            echo "Run 'npm run bump:patch|minor|major' from frontend/ — it updates all four files."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
            TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
            echo "Release tag:                $TAG_VERSION"
            if [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$PACKAGE_VERSION" ] || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$LOCK_VERSION" ] \
              || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$LOCK_ROOT_VERSION" ] || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$PYPROJECT_VERSION" ] \
              || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$UV_LOCK_VERSION" ]; then
              echo "Release tag v$TAG_VERSION does not match all release metadata."
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "Ordinary PRs and main pushes do not need a version bump."
          fi

  # Aggregate gate exposed to callers as outputs.passed / outputs.frontend_result.
  result:
    name: "Aggregate result"
    needs: [changes, frontend, backend, version-policy]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      frontend_result: ${{ needs.frontend.result }}
      passed: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.passed }}
    steps:
      - name: "Require all checks to pass"
        id: gate
        run: |
          echo "changes=${{ needs.changes.result }} frontend=${{ needs.frontend.result }} backend=${{ needs.backend.result }} version-policy=${{ needs.version-policy.result }}"
          # Change-detection must succeed, else we'd skip everything and pass blindly.
          if [ "${{ needs.changes.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "Change detection failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          # frontend/backend may be legitimately "skipped" when their area was untouched.
          for res in "${{ needs.frontend.result }}" "${{ needs.backend.result }}"; do
            if [ "$res" != "success" ] && [ "$res" != "skipped" ]; then
              echo "A build/test job failed ($res)."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          # The always-on gate job must pass outright.
          if [ "${{ needs.version-policy.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "A required gate job failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All checks passed (skipped = no changes in that area)."
          echo "passed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Checks

# Reusable: build/test/lint everything and report whether it passed. Called
# by check-build.yml on every push/PR — including the release workflow's
# release PRs, so a release exercises this exact suite before it can merge.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      run-all:
        description: >-
          Run every area's checks regardless of changed paths. Release runs
          must always validate the full app, not just what a diff touched.
        type: boolean
        default: false
        required: false
    outputs:
      frontend_result:
        description: "Result of the frontend job (success/skipped/failure/...)."
        value: ${{ jobs.result.outputs.frontend_result }}
      passed:
        description: "true if every required check passed (or was legitimately skipped)."
        value: ${{ jobs.result.outputs.passed }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  # Detect which areas a PR touched so the irrelevant heavy jobs can be
  # skipped. On push/tag/run-all we always run everything (full validation).
  changes:
    name: "Detect changed areas"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      frontend: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.frontend }}
      backend: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.backend }}
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Filter changed paths"
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v4
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            frontend:
              - 'frontend/**'
              - '.github/workflows/checks.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/check-build.yml'
            backend:
              - 'backend/**'
              - '.github/workflows/checks.yml'
              - '.github/workflows/check-build.yml'

  frontend:
    name: "Frontend (build + test + i18n)"
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ inputs.run-all || github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.frontend == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Set up Node.js"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: npm ci

      - name: "Type-check & build"
        run: npm run build

      - name: "Bundle size budget"
        run: npm run check-bundle-size

      - name: "Unit tests"
        run: npx vitest run

      - name: "Translation parity"
        run: npm run check-i18n

      - name: "No explicit any"
        run: npm run check-no-any

  backend:
    name: "Backend (deps + checks)"
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ inputs.run-all || github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.backend == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Set up uv"
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: "Lint (ruff)"
        run: uv run ruff check

      - name: "Compile & import checks"
        run: |
          uv run python -m compileall -q app alembic
          uv run python -c "import app.main; print('app imports OK')"

      - name: "Unit tests"
        # -n auto fans the suite across the runner's cores (pytest-xdist).
        # Tests are isolation-safe: each gets its own SQLite DB via tmp_path.
        run: uv run pytest -n auto

    name: "Version metadata policy"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout Code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: "Check package metadata"
        run: |
          PACKAGE_VERSION=$(jq -r .version frontend/package.json)
          LOCK_VERSION=$(jq -r .version frontend/package-lock.json)
          LOCK_ROOT_VERSION=$(jq -r '.packages[""].version' frontend/package-lock.json)
          PYPROJECT_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' backend/pyproject.toml | head -1)

          echo "frontend/package.json:      $PACKAGE_VERSION"
          echo "frontend/package-lock.json: $LOCK_VERSION"
          echo "lock root package:          $LOCK_ROOT_VERSION"
          echo "backend/pyproject.toml:     $PYPROJECT_VERSION"
          echo "backend/uv.lock:            $UV_LOCK_VERSION"

          if [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$LOCK_VERSION" ] || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$LOCK_ROOT_VERSION" ] \
            || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$PYPROJECT_VERSION" ] || [ "$PACKAGE_VERSION" != "$UV_LOCK_VERSION" ]; then

            echo "Run 'npm run bump:patch|minor|major' from frontend/ — it updates all four files."
            exit 1

            echo "Release tag:                $TAG_VERSION"

              || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$LOCK_ROOT_VERSION" ] || [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$PYPROJECT_VERSION" ] \

    needs: [changes, frontend, backend, version-policy]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      frontend_result: ${{ needs.frontend.result }}
      passed: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.passed }}
    steps:

          echo "changes=${{ needs.changes.result }} frontend=${{ needs.frontend.result }} backend=${{ needs.backend.result }} version-policy=${{ needs.version-policy.result }}"

            exit 1

            exit 1
          fi
